body:
### Question

What's the correct solution if I want to be able to execute a command provided by a uv project from anywhere in the system? (without having to execute `uv run command` from within the project)

For now I'm using a bash wrapper in my `~/bin` that just executes:

`uv run --project /home/me/path/to/project command $@`

Seems to work fine: are there any drawbacks? Better solutions?

Maybe this topic should be mentioned in the docs? You already do it here for scripts https://docs.astral.sh/uv/guides/scripts/#using-a-shebang-to-create-an-executable-file but I couldn't find a similar suggestion to run commands instead of scripts.
